description: Extract text or structured data from the webpage according to an extraction instruction.

collectionId.description: Returned by the first mode call; pass it to resume the same collection.

instruction.description: Extraction guidance or prompt (e.g. "Extract all product prices and titles").

mode.description: Self-checking collection. "rows" saves list records, follows Next or scrolls the list, rechecks a load that adds nothing, and stops at target or at the total the pager claims. "chunk" reads long text in paragraph-sized chunks and records the section reached. Each call works for up to about 12 s; call again with collectionId until complete is true or stopReason explains the shortfall.

ref.description: Element reference from browser_snapshot (e.g. "@e12"). Preferred over index; also used to target a scroll container.

schema.description: JSON Schema, validated without eval. Unsupported keywords return an explicit error. Extraction uses the configured model.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction.

since.description: Return only rows (or text characters) after this count; pass nextSince from the previous call.

tabId.description: Optional browser tab id to act on instead of the focused tab.

target.description: With mode="rows": how many records to collect. Without it, one capture of the current list.

name: browser_extract
